title: TaskPress: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Compression via Task-Guided Pruning
abstract: arXiv:2608.03276v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Long-context inference with large language models is constrained by the linear growth of the key-value cache to sequence length. While pruning offers mitigation, prevailing methods determine query-specific token importance that cannot be reused across unseen queries. In contrast, we introduce TaskPress, a framework for task-guided, query-agnostic KV cache eviction. Instead of optimizing the cache for a single query, TaskPress constructs a reusable memory representation conditioned on a high-level task guide. The guide functions as a meta-query during prefill to filter irrelevant tokens before downstream queries are issued. In addition, TaskPress leverages quantization scale factors as a zero-cost signal for detecting influential representation outliers, providing an efficient proxy for token importance. translated_title: TaskPress：基于任务引导剪枝的查询无关KV缓存压缩
translated_abstract: 使用大语言模型进行长上下文推理受到键值缓存随序列长度线性增长的限制。虽然剪枝可以缓解这一问题，但现有方法确定的查询特定token重要性无法在未见过的查询之间复用。相比之下，我们提出了TaskPress，一个任务引导的、查询无关的KV缓存淘汰框架。TaskPress不再针对单个查询优化缓存，而是基于高级任务指南构建可复用的内存表示。该指南在预填充阶段充当元查询，在下游查询发出之前过滤无关token。此外，TaskPress利用量化缩放因子作为零成本信号来检测有影响力的表示离群值，为token重要性提供高效的代理指标。在各种长上下文输入任务上进行的实验表明，TaskPress能够高效地创建紧凑、可复用的缓存表示。
tldr: TaskPress提出了一种任务引导、查询无关的KV缓存压缩框架，通过高级任务指南在预填充阶段充当元查询过滤无关token，并创新性地利用量化缩放因子作为零成本的token重要性信号，构建可跨查询复用的紧凑缓存表示。
en_tdlr: TaskPress introduces a task-guided, query-agnostic KV cache compression framework that uses a high-level task guide as a meta-query during prefill to filter irrelevant tokens and leverages quantization scale factors as a zero-cost signal for token importance, enabling a compact and reusable cache representation across queries.
